proposals.headline: Large-enterprise demand remains supportive
proposals.whatChanged: Reported revenue exceeded the team forecast and management described record regulated-industry pipeline.
proposals.againstOurView: The approved pillar expects durable large-enterprise demand despite budget scrutiny.
proposals.whyItMatters: The quarter supports the demand pillar and raises confidence in the enterprise pipeline.
proposals.recommendedFollowUp: Track regulated-industry conversion and certification timing.

proposals.headline: Mid-market demand durability is less certain
proposals.whatChanged: Net revenue retention was 114%, below the team's 118%–122% range, and management cited longer implementation cycles.
proposals.againstOurView: The approved pillar assumes stable implementation velocity and resilient mid-market expansion.
proposals.whyItMatters: A sustained implementation slowdown would reduce confidence in FY2027 expansion assumptions.
uncertainties: Management did not quantify how long the implementation-cycle effect will persist.
proposals.recommendedFollowUp: Revisit FY2027 net-retention assumptions after cohort and implementation data is available.

proposals.headline: Q3 revenue forecast requires upward review
proposals.whatChanged: Company guidance implies a $551m midpoint versus the team's $540m base case.
proposals.whyItMatters: The guidance midpoint is approximately 2.0% above the current base case.
uncertainties: Guidance basis is synthetic and should be reviewed with margin and seasonality assumptions.
proposals.recommendedFollowUp: Open the team model and review the Q3 revenue bridge.

proposals.headline: Separate implementation capacity from end-demand weakness
proposals.whatChanged: Management attributed mid-market weakness to deployment complexity but did not provide cohort evidence.
proposals.againstOurView: The current case does not distinguish delayed implementation from lower underlying demand.
proposals.whyItMatters: The two explanations imply different forecast and valuation consequences.
uncertainties: No cohort-level conversion or delay duration was disclosed.
proposals.recommendedFollowUp: Request cohort conversion data and track pilot-to-production duration.

value.question: Is mid-market weakness caused by implementation capacity or lower underlying demand?
